completed_this_session.P001_PNG_INVESTIGATION_CLOSED: Open since 2026-10-10 as 'unexplained and uninvestigated' in a PUBLISHED product. Root cause: the PNG records its own renderer in a tEXt chunk -- committed says Matplotlib 3.10.9, this container ships 3.11.2. Byte sizes reproduced EXACTLY, 66047 -> 75602. NOT metadata and NOT anti-aliasing: 11.56% of pixels differ, max channel delta 255, median 95, 4.77% differ by >128; ink quantity nearly unchanged 59134 -> 58591 but ink IoU 0.257, and no shift within +/-12px raises it above 0.332. Mechanism: two histtype=step histograms, 220 bins at 1.2pt across ~1000px, a dense thin zigzag whose Agg rasterization is version-sensitive; second IDAT grows 351 -> 9906 bytes because less pixel-aligned lines compress worse. THE DATA DID NOT CHANGE: script is seeded (n=300000, seed=5) and the rerun prints P_fade=9.2667e-04 against the README's 9.27e-04. P001 needs no correction. DELIBERATELY NOT regenerated -- that pins the artifact to 3.11.2 and moves the same problem to the next upgrade. Full analysis in tracking/FINDING_P001_PNG_RENDERER_DEPENDENCE.md.
completed_this_session.DRIFT_QUESTION_ANSWERED_BY_MEASUREMENT: The full gate run left 28 tracked files modified (P051 1, P052 3, P054 9, P055 2, P056 1, P058 12). All 131 paired changed lines were compared TOKEN BY TOKEN. Every one is (a) wall-clock or derived timing, (b) the platform.platform() kernel string Linux-6.18.44-fc-v80 -> -fc-v114 which accounts for ALL NINE P054 files, or (c) hypothesis 6.168.5 -> 6.169.0. NO MEASURED SCIENTIFIC QUANTITY MOVED ANYWHERE -- means, errors, CI bounds, counts, probabilities and every PASS/FAIL verdict identical. Example: a whole row of P054 validate_surrogate.txt is byte-identical (mean 3.718990, error -2.607e-06, CI 3.71791/3.72007, final 6.454e-05) except one column, 0.05 -> 0.06, which is seconds. CONCLUSION: bit-for-bit reproducibility of committed OUTPUTS is unachievable in the current format because the outputs deliberately record their environment; NUMERICAL reproducibility IS achieved. The 2026-10-11 narrowing was right and is reinforced. Assert reproducibility over numbers, never over bytes.

P053_THE_ONE_DECISION.what_it_is: products/P053/validation/validate_thresholds.py exits 1 BY DESIGN. It publishes two genuinely failing variance-CUSUM threshold-transfer checks -- bias -8.6% at T=200 and +13.5% at T=1000 against a declared 8.8% tolerance -- rather than widening the tolerance until they pass. That is ADR-011 working as written. Gate check 6 requires every validation/*.py to exit 0, so the gate reads an honest measurement as a broken script.
P053_THE_ONE_DECISION.NEW_EVIDENCE_THAT_REFRAMES_IT: This is NOT novel and the repo already has a settled convention. P025 CARRIES TWO REPORTED-FAILED CHECKS AND PASSES THE GATE, because they print FAILED and EXIT 0. The identical conflict arose with P035 on 2026-10-02. So P053 and P035 DEVIATE FROM THE REPOSITORY'S OWN CONVENTION. Option (A) is 'bring P053 into line with P025', not 'loosen a check'.
P053_THE_ONE_DECISION.DO_NOT_RETRY_UNATTENDED: On 2026-10-02 a session tried changing P035's return 1 to return 0 and the SAFETY CLASSIFIER REFUSED IT AS A CI BYPASS -- correctly, since from outside it is indistinguishable from editing a check to pass. After that the classifier denied every further gate-adjacent command. Standing instruction: do not retry this in an unattended session. NOT retried tonight.
P053_THE_ONE_DECISION.options: (A) the gate honours a declared expected_exit or honest_negative:true marker -- or equivalently and more cheaply P053 adopts the P025 convention, printing every FAILED line and number verbatim and exiting 0. (B) ADR-011 negatives report through a mechanism that exits 0 while keeping the FAILED lines verbatim.
P053_THE_ONE_DECISION.argument_worth_putting: The gate's own header says the rule it enforces is 'the product actually works', not 'the test command exited 0'. Check 6 currently conflates 'did the validation run' with 'did every measured quantity land inside tolerance'. Either option separates them and NEITHER HIDES ANYTHING.
P053_THE_ONE_DECISION.BUNDLE_THIS_FIX_WITH_IT: The gate reports 'validate_thresholds.py exit 1: no output', which reads like a silent crash. check_scripts reports the last line of STDERR; P053 writes its entire diagnosis to STDOUT and nothing to stderr, so last is empty and it prints 'no output'. THE GATE PRESENTS THE MISSION'S MOST CAREFULLY REPORTED HONEST NEGATIVE AS A SILENT CRASH. Diagnostic defect, not a verdict defect. NOT fixed here -- it is an edit to the publication authority -- and it lives in the same function as the P053 decision.
